station_name: Los Gatos Creek at Los Gatos, Calif.
notes: Table is 'Monthly and yearly diversions, in acre-feet' under stream station 1680 (continued). Rules do not say how to type a diversion table printed under a stream gauge: kept Stream Discharge because the station is on the creek (could be Irrigation); variable given as discharge (diverted volume). Santa Clara County is printed on the page only for the next station (1685), so county left blank. Count: water year 1929 has only Sept. (1 value); 1930-1960 = 31 years x 12 months = 372; total 373 monthly values. 'The year' column: 31 yearly totals (1929 is a dash), summary only.
